[2:36PM] #VictoriaIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is currently building up from Kofo Abayomi towards Kilimanjaro. This congestion continues along Kilimanjaro inward to Akin Adeshola and extends towards the Law School, resulting in busy but flowing conditions down to the Civic Centre. 
This increased traffic volume is attributed to a high number of vehicles on the road combined with the typical rush hour as businesses close for the day.

Moving eastward, the situation appears more favorable. The flow of traffic from Civic Centre towards 1004, connecting through School Corner and onward to Sandfield, is reported to be encouraging at this time. Furthermore, the stretch from Sandfield heading towards the Toll Plaza and ultimately down to Lekki is currently experiencing good traffic conditions, indicating a smooth drive for commuters in that direction.
